"""Tests for per-run single-run concurrency quotas (``max_parallelism``)."""

import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout

from flowd.cli import main
from flowd.model import WorkflowError
from flowd.scheduler import Scheduler
from flowd.store import STEP_RUNNING, WorkflowStore, atomic_write_json

FAN = [{"id": "a", "depends_on": []}, {"id": "b", "depends_on": []},
       {"id": "c", "depends_on": []}]


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start=1_700_000_000.0):
        self.value = float(start)

    def __call__(self):
        return self.value

    def advance(self, seconds):
        self.value += float(seconds)
        return self.value


class QuotaTestBase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="flowd-quota-")
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.root, True)
        self.clock = FakeClock()
        self.store = WorkflowStore(self.root, clock=self.clock)
        self.scheduler = Scheduler(self.store, clock=self.clock)

    def workflow(self, workflow_id="fan", steps=None):
        return self.scheduler.submit("acme", workflow_id, steps or FAN)

    def start(self, max_parallelism=None, workflow_id="fan", run_id="r1", tenant="acme"):
        return self.scheduler.start_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id=run_id,
                                        max_parallelism=max_parallelism)

    def claim(self, run_id="r1", worker="w1", lease=30, tenant="acme"):
        return self.scheduler.claim(tenant, run_id, worker, lease)


class QuotaConfigTest(QuotaTestBase):
    def test_quota_is_stored_and_reported(self):
        self.workflow()
        run = self.start(max_parallelism=2)
        self.assertEqual(run["max_parallelism"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")["max_parallelism"], 2)

    def test_omitted_or_null_quota_means_unlimited(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.assertIsNone(self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "fan", run_id="r1")
                          ["max_parallelism"])
        self.assertIsNone(self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "fan", run_id="r2",
                                                   max_parallelism=None)["max_parallelism"])

    def test_invalid_quota_is_rejected_and_creates_no_run(self):
        self.workflow()
        for bad in (True, False, 1.5, 0.0, "2", 0, -1, -3, [], {}):
            with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
                self.start(max_parallelism=bad, run_id="bad-%r" % (bad,))
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_max_parallelism")
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.list_runs("acme")[0], [])

    def test_old_run_without_field_reads_as_null(self):
        self.workflow()
        run = self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        path = os.path.join(self.root, "acme", "runs", "r1.json")
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            doc = json.load(handle)
        del doc["max_parallelism"]
        atomic_write_json(path, doc)
        reloaded = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", run["run_id"])
        self.assertIsNone(reloaded["max_parallelism"])
        # unlimited: every independent task can be held at once
        self.assertEqual(self.claim()["id"], "a")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w2")["id"], "b")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w3")["id"], "c")

    def test_quota_is_fixed_after_creation(self):
        self.workflow()
        run = self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        self.claim()
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", "r1", "a", "w1")
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")["max_parallelism"], 1)


class QuotaEnforcementTest(QuotaTestBase):
    def test_quota_blocks_claims_and_keeps_ready_steps_ready(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        first = self.claim()
        self.assertEqual(first["id"], "a")
        history_before = len(self.scheduler.history("r1", "acme"))
        blocked = self.claim(worker="w2")
        self.assertIsNone(blocked)
        run = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["b"]["status"], "ready")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["c"]["status"], "ready")
        # a blocked claim adds no claim history of its own
        history = self.scheduler.history("r1", "acme")
        self.assertEqual(len(history), history_before)
        self.assertEqual([e for e in history if e["type"] == "claim"],
                         [e for e in history[:history_before] if e["type"] == "claim"])

    def test_completing_releases_a_slot(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        self.assertEqual(self.claim()["id"], "a")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w2"))
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", "r1", "a", "w1")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w2")["id"], "b")

    def test_failing_releases_a_slot_via_retry(self):
        self.workflow("flaky", [{"id": "a", "depends_on": [], "max_attempts": 3},
                                {"id": "b", "depends_on": []}])
        self.start(workflow_id="flaky", max_parallelism=1)
        self.assertEqual(self.claim()["id"], "a")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w2"))
        self.scheduler.fail("acme", "r1", "a", "w1", "boom")
        # the retry slot is freed, but "a" is backing off; the due task "b"
        # is handed out instead of blocking behind the waiting retry
        again = self.claim(worker="w2")
        self.assertEqual((again["id"], again["status"], again["attempt"]), ("b", "running", 0))
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", "r1", "b", "w2")
        self.clock.advance(1)  # backoff of "a" elapses
        retried = self.claim(worker="w2")
        self.assertEqual((retried["id"], retried["attempt"]), ("a", 1))

    def test_same_worker_holding_multiple_tasks_is_counted_per_task(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=2)
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w1")["id"], "a")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w1")["id"], "b")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w1"))
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", "r1", "a", "w1")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w1")["id"], "c")

    def test_approval_nodes_do_not_consume_quota(self):
        self.scheduler.submit("acme", "gated", [
            {"id": "a", "depends_on": []},
            {"id": "g", "depends_on": [], "kind": "approval"},
            {"id": "b", "depends_on": []},
        ])
        self.start(workflow_id="gated", max_parallelism=1)
        self.assertEqual(self.claim()["id"], "a")
        run = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["g"]["status"], "waiting")
        # deciding the approval does not free the task slot
        self.scheduler.decide("acme", "r1", "g", "boss", "approve")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w2"))
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", "r1", "a", "w1")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w2")["id"], "b")

    def test_heartbeat_neither_takes_nor_releases_a_slot(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        self.claim(lease=30)
        self.clock.advance(10)
        self.scheduler.heartbeat("acme", "r1", "a", "w1", 60)
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w2"))
        self.clock.advance(60)  # original deadline long gone, renewed deadline reached
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w2", lease=5)["id"], "a")

    def test_expired_lease_frees_the_slot_and_keeps_takeover_history(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        self.claim(worker="w1", lease=5)
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w2"))
        self.clock.advance(5)  # deadline == now counts as expired
        taken = self.claim(worker="w2", lease=5)
        self.assertEqual((taken["id"], taken["worker_id"]), ("a", "w2"))
        events = self.scheduler.history("r1", "acme")
        takeovers = [e for e in events if e["type"] == "takeover"]
        self.assertEqual(len(takeovers), 1)
        self.assertEqual(takeovers[0]["worker_id"], "w1")

    def test_quota_is_isolated_per_run_and_tenant(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.scheduler.submit("globex", "fan", FAN)
        self.start(max_parallelism=1, run_id="r1")
        self.start(max_parallelism=1, run_id="r2")
        globex = self.scheduler.start_run("globex", "fan", run_id="r3", max_parallelism=1)
        for run_id, tenant in (("r1", "acme"), ("r2", "acme"),
                               (globex["run_id"], "globex")):
            self.assertEqual(self.claim(run_id, tenant=tenant)["id"], "a")
            self.assertIsNone(self.claim(run_id, worker="w2", tenant=tenant))
        # completing in one run does not affect the others
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", "r1", "a", "w1")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim("r1", worker="w9")["id"], "b")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim("r2", worker="w9"))

    def test_unlimited_quota_allows_every_ready_lease(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start()  # no quota
        for expected, worker in (("a", "w1"), ("b", "w2"), ("c", "w3")):
            self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker=worker)["id"], expected)
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w4"))

    def test_bad_claim_arguments_do_not_consume_a_slot(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        for bad in (lambda: self.scheduler.claim("acme", "r1", "  ", 30),
                    lambda: self.scheduler.claim("acme", "r1", "w1", 0),
                    lambda: self.scheduler.claim("acme", "r1", "w1", True)):
            with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError):
                bad()
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(worker="w1")["id"], "a")

    def test_concurrent_claims_never_oversubscribe(self):
        self.scheduler.submit("acme", "wide",
                              [{"id": "t%02d" % i, "depends_on": []} for i in range(6)])
        self.start(workflow_id="wide", run_id="r1", max_parallelism=2)
        results = []
        barrier = threading.Barrier(6)

        def grab(worker):
            barrier.wait()
            results.append(self.claim(worker=worker))

        threads = [threading.Thread(target=grab, args=("w%d" % i,)) for i in range(6)]
        for thread in threads:
            thread.start()
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join()
        held = [s for s in self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")["steps"].values()
                if s["status"] == STEP_RUNNING]
        self.assertEqual(len(held), 2)
        self.assertEqual(sum(1 for r in results if r is None), 4)


class QuotaReplayAndRestartTest(QuotaTestBase):
    def test_replay_preserves_quota_config_and_lease_state(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        self.claim(worker="w1", lease=30)
        replayed = self.scheduler.replay("acme", "r1")
        self.assertEqual(replayed["max_parallelism"], 1)
        step = replayed["steps"]["a"]
        stored = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")
        self.assertEqual((step["status"], step["worker_id"], step["lease_deadline"]),
                         ("running", "w1", stored["steps"]["a"]["lease_deadline"]))

    def test_restarted_store_keeps_counting_existing_leases(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        self.claim(worker="w1", lease=30)
        restarted = Scheduler(WorkflowStore(self.root, clock=self.clock), clock=self.clock)
        self.assertIsNone(restarted.claim("acme", "r1", "w2", 30))
        self.clock.advance(30)
        self.assertEqual(restarted.claim("acme", "r1", "w2", 5)["id"], "a")


class QuotaCliTest(QuotaTestBase):
    def cli(self, *argv):
        output = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            code = main(["--data-dir", self.root] + list(argv))
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, output.getvalue())
        return json.loads(output.getvalue())

    def test_status_shows_max_parallelism(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        body = self.cli("status", "--run-id", "r1", "--tenant", "acme")
        self.assertEqual(body["max_parallelism"], 1)

    def test_status_shows_null_for_old_run(self):
        self.workflow()
        self.start(max_parallelism=1)
        path = os.path.join(self.root, "acme", "runs", "r1.json")
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            doc = json.load(handle)
        del doc["max_parallelism"]
        atomic_write_json(path, doc)
        body = self.cli("status", "--run-id", "r1", "--tenant", "acme")
        self.assertIsNone(body["max_parallelism"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

1	"""Persistence for flowd: workflows, runs, tenants and append-only history.
2	
3	Layout::
4	
5	    <root>/<tenant>/workflows.json
6	    <root>/<tenant>/idempotency.json
7	    <root>/<tenant>/workers.json
8	    <root>/<tenant>/schedules.json
9	    <root>/<tenant>/audit.json
10	    <root>/<tenant>/runs/<run_id>.json
11	
12	Every write is atomic (temp file + ``os.replace``) so a crash cannot leave a
13	half written run behind, and a fresh store over the same root sees exactly
14	the same workflows and runs.
15	"""
16	
17	import json
18	import os
19	import threading
20	import time as _time
21	import uuid

26	RUN_PENDING = "pending"
27	RUN_RUNNING = "running"
28	RUN_SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
29	RUN_FAILED = "failed"
30	RUN_CANCELLED = "cancelled"

33	STEP_READY = "ready"

35	STEP_WAITING = "waiting"

43	def atomic_write_json(path, payload):
44	    """Write ``payload`` as JSON to ``path`` atomically."""
45	    directory = os.path.dirname(path)
46	    if directory:
47	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
48	    tmp = "%s.tmp.%d" % (path, os.getpid())
49	    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
50	        json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
51	        handle.flush()
52	        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
53	    os.replace(tmp, path)

56	def read_json(path, default=None):

58	        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
59	            return json.load(handle)
60	    except FileNotFoundError:

"""Persistence for flowd: workflows, runs, tenants and append-only history.

Layout::

    <root>/<tenant>/workflows.json
    <root>/<tenant>/idempotency.json
    <root>/<tenant>/workers.json
    <root>/<tenant>/schedules.json
    <root>/<tenant>/audit.json
    <root>/<tenant>/runs/<run_id>.json

Every write is atomic (temp file + ``os.replace``) so a crash cannot leave a
half written run behind, and a fresh store over the same root sees exactly
the same workflows and runs.
"""

import json
import os
import threading
import time as _time
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager

from .model import KIND_TASK, WorkflowError, format_time, plan_workflow

RUN_PENDING = "pending"
RUN_RUNNING = "running"
RUN_SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
RUN_FAILED = "failed"
RUN_CANCELLED = "cancelled"

STEP_PENDING = "pending"
STEP_READY = "ready"
STEP_RUNNING = "running"
STEP_WAITING = "waiting"
STEP_SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
STEP_FAILED = "failed"
STEP_CANCELLED = "cancelled"

TERMINAL_RUN_STATES = (RUN_SUCCEEDED, RUN_FAILED, RUN_CANCELLED)


def atomic_write_json(path, payload):
    """Write ``payload`` as JSON to ``path`` atomically."""
    directory = os.path.dirname(path)
    if directory:
        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = "%s.tmp.%d" % (path, os.getpid())
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
        handle.flush()
        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def read_json(path, default=None):
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            return json.load(handle)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return default


class WorkflowStore:
    """Filesystem backed store for one data directory (all tenants)."""

    def __init__(self, root, clock=None):
        self.root = os.path.abspath(root)
        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else _time.time
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        os.makedirs(self.root, exist_ok=True)

    def now(self):
        return float(self._clock())

    def now_iso(self):
        return format_time(self.now())

    @contextmanager
    def locked(self):
        with self._lock:
            yield

    # -- paths ---------------------------------------------------------
    def tenant_dir(self, tenant):
        if not isinstance(tenant, str) or not tenant.strip():
            raise WorkflowError("tenant must be a non-empty string", "bad_tenant")
        return os.path.join(self.root, tenant.strip())

    def workflows_path(self, tenant):
        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "workflows.json")

    def idempotency_path(self, tenant):
        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "idempotency.json")

    def workers_path(self, tenant):
        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "workers.json")

    def schedules_path(self, tenant):
        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "schedules.json")

    def audit_path(self, tenant):
        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "audit.json")

    def run_path(self, tenant, run_id):
        return os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs", "%s.json" % run_id)

    def generate_run_id(self):
        return "run-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]

    # -- workflows -----------------------------------------------------
    def save_workflow(self, tenant, workflow_id, steps):
        plan = plan_workflow(workflow_id, steps)
        with self._lock:
            data = self.load_workflows(tenant)
            data[plan["workflow_id"]] = plan
            atomic_write_json(self.workflows_path(tenant), data)
        return plan

    def load_workflows(self, tenant):
        return read_json(self.workflows_path(tenant), {}) or {}

    def get_workflow(self, tenant, workflow_id):
        plan = self.load_workflows(tenant).get(workflow_id)
        if plan is None:
            raise WorkflowError("unknown workflow: %s" % workflow_id, "unknown_workflow")
        return plan

    # -- idempotency index --------------------------------------------
    def load_idempotency(self, tenant):
        """Return the tenant's ``{trimmed key: {"run_id": ...}}`` map."""
        return read_json(self.idempotency_path(tenant), {}) or {}

    def save_idempotency(self, tenant, index):
        atomic_write_json(self.idempotency_path(tenant), index)
        return index

    # -- worker registry ----------------------------------------------
    def load_workers(self, tenant):
        """Return the tenant's ``{worker_id: registration record}`` map."""
        return read_json(self.workers_path(tenant), {}) or {}

    def save_workers(self, tenant, index):
        atomic_write_json(self.workers_path(tenant), index)
        return index

    # -- schedule registry --------------------------------------------
    def load_schedules(self, tenant):
        """Return the tenant's ``{schedule_id: schedule record}`` map."""
        return read_json(self.schedules_path(tenant), {}) or {}

    def save_schedules(self, tenant, index):
        atomic_write_json(self.schedules_path(tenant), index)
        return index

    def schedule_exists(self, schedule_id):
        """Return the tenant owning ``schedule_id``, or ``None``."""
        for tenant in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
            if schedule_id in (read_json(self.schedules_path(tenant), {}) or {}):
                return tenant
        return None

    # -- audit stream ---------------------------------------------------
    def append_audit(self, tenant, action, at=None, run_id=None, step_id=None,
                     workflow_id=None, schedule_id=None, worker_id=None, actor=None):
        """Append one record to the tenant's audit stream.

        The ``sequence`` is assigned under the store lock, so concurrent
        appends stay unique and follow commit order, and it continues from
        the persisted stream, so a restart keeps increasing.  Only
        identifiers and the actor are stored — never params, results or
        error text; identifiers that do not apply are ``None``.
        """
        with self._lock:
            path = self.audit_path(tenant)
            items = (read_json(path, None) or {}).get("items") or []
            record = {
                "sequence": (items[-1]["sequence"] + 1) if items else 1,
                "at": at if at is not None else self.now_iso(),
                "tenant": tenant.strip(),
                "action": action,
                "run_id": run_id,
                "step_id": step_id,
                "workflow_id": workflow_id,
                "schedule_id": schedule_id,
                "worker_id": worker_id,
                "actor": actor,
            }
            items.append(record)
            atomic_write_json(path, {"items": items})
            return dict(record)

    def load_audit(self, tenant):
        """Return the tenant's audit records in sequence order (read-only)."""
        return list((read_json(self.audit_path(tenant), None) or {}).get("items") or [])

    # -- runs ----------------------------------------------------------
    def save_run(self, run):
        atomic_write_json(self.run_path(run["tenant"], run["run_id"]), run)
        return run

    def load_run(self, tenant, run_id):
        run = read_json(self.run_path(tenant, run_id), None)
        if run is None:
            raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
        return normalize_run(run)

    def run_exists(self, run_id):
        """Return the tenant owning ``run_id``, or ``None``."""
        for tenant in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
            if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(self.root, tenant, "runs", "%s.json" % run_id)):
                return tenant
        return None

    def load_all_runs(self, tenant):
        """Return every run of the tenant as a list sorted by ``run_id``."""
        runs_dir = os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs")
        items = []
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(runs_dir)) if os.path.isdir(runs_dir) else []:
            run = read_json(os.path.join(runs_dir, name), None) if name.endswith(".json") else None
            if run is not None:
                items.append(normalize_run(run))
        items.sort(key=lambda r: r.get("run_id", ""))
        return items

    def list_runs(self, tenant, status=None, limit=50, after=None):
        runs_dir = os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs")
        items = []
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(runs_dir)) if os.path.isdir(runs_dir) else []:
            run = read_json(os.path.join(runs_dir, name), None) if name.endswith(".json") else None
            if run is not None:
                items.append(normalize_run(run))
        items.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("created_at", ""), r.get("run_id", "")))
        if status:
            items = [r for r in items if r.get("status") == status]
        if after:
            position = [i for i, r in enumerate(items) if r.get("run_id") == after]
            items = items[position[0] + 1:] if position else []
        limit = max(1, int(limit))
        page = items[:limit]
        return page, (page[-1]["run_id"] if len(items) > limit else None)


def normalize_run(run):
    """Backfill fields missing from documents written by older versions.

    Steps without ``kind`` predate approval nodes and are ordinary tasks.
    Runs without ``max_parallelism`` predate per-run concurrency quotas and
    have no limit (``None``).  Runs without ``idempotency_key`` predate
    tenant-scoped idempotency keys and never participate in dedup (``None``).
    Runs without ``not_before`` predate delayed start and begin immediately
    (``None``).  Runs without ``schedule_id``/``scheduled_at`` predate
    periodic scheduling and were created manually (``None``).  Steps without
    ``next_attempt_at`` predate retry backoff and are immediately claimable
    (``None``).  Runs without a frozen ``plan`` predate per-run DAG snapshots
    and reconstruct theirs from the node definitions and ``step_order`` saved
    in the run document itself, so replay never has to read the workflow
    registry (which a later same-name submission may have overwritten).
    Mutates and returns ``run``.
    """
    run.setdefault("max_parallelism", None)
    run.setdefault("idempotency_key", None)
    run.setdefault("not_before", None)
    run.setdefault("schedule_id", None)
    run.setdefault("scheduled_at", None)
    for step in run.get("steps", {}).values():
        step.setdefault("kind", KIND_TASK)
        step.setdefault("approval", None)
        step.setdefault("next_attempt_at", None)
    if not run.get("plan"):
        run["plan"] = plan_from_run(run)
    return run


def plan_from_run(run):
    """Reconstruct a normalized plan from the definitions frozen in a run.

    The run document keeps each node's ``kind``, ``depends_on`` and
    ``max_attempts`` together with ``step_order``; those are exactly the
    fields a plan needs, so documents written before plans were snapshotted
    remain replayable even after the workflow of the same id is overwritten
    or deleted.
    """
    steps = run.get("steps") or {}
    order = [sid for sid in (run.get("step_order") or sorted(steps)) if sid in steps]
    ordered = [
        {
            "id": steps[sid]["id"],
            "depends_on": list(steps[sid].get("depends_on") or []),
            "max_attempts": steps[sid]["max_attempts"],
            "kind": steps[sid].get("kind", KIND_TASK),
        }
        for sid in order
    ]
    return {
        "workflow_id": run.get("workflow_id"),
        "steps": ordered,
        "order": [step["id"] for step in ordered],
    }


def run_plan(run):
    """Return the normalized DAG plan frozen into ``run`` at creation.

    Newer documents carry an explicit snapshot under ``plan``; older ones
    reconstruct it via :func:`plan_from_run` from the run's own nodes and
    ordering.  The result is a fresh copy, so callers can never mutate the
    snapshot stored in the run document.
    """
    snapshot = run.get("plan")
    if not snapshot or not snapshot.get("steps"):
        snapshot = plan_from_run(run)
    return {
        "workflow_id": snapshot.get("workflow_id", run.get("workflow_id")),
        "steps": [dict(step) for step in snapshot.get("steps", [])],
        "order": list(snapshot.get("order", [])),
    }


def new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, now_iso, max_parallelism=None,
            idempotency_key=None, not_before=None, schedule_id=None, scheduled_at=None):
    """Build a fresh run document from a validated plan."""
    steps = {
        step["id"]: {
            "id": step["id"],
            "kind": step.get("kind", KIND_TASK),
            "depends_on": list(step["depends_on"]),
            "max_attempts": step["max_attempts"],
            "status": STEP_PENDING,
            "attempt": 0,
            "worker_id": None,
            "lease_deadline": None,
            "next_attempt_at": None,
            "ready_at": None,
            "started_at": None,
            "finished_at": None,
            "result": None,
            "error": None,
            "approval": None,
        }
        for step in plan["steps"]
    }
    return {
        "tenant": tenant,
        "workflow_id": workflow_id,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "status": RUN_PENDING,
        "params": params or {},
        "max_parallelism": max_parallelism,
        "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
        "not_before": not_before,
        "schedule_id": schedule_id,
        "scheduled_at": scheduled_at,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso,
        # The normalized DAG as it was when this run was created.  A later
        # submission of another workflow with the same id must not rewrite
        # this run's nodes, order, kinds, dependencies or max_attempts;
        # replay rebuilds exclusively from this snapshot.
        "plan": {
            "workflow_id": plan["workflow_id"],
            "steps": [dict(step) for step in plan["steps"]],
            "order": list(plan["order"]),
        },
        "step_order": list(plan["order"]),
        "order_index": {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(plan["order"])},
        "steps": steps,
        "history": [],
    }

229	def params_equal(left, right):
230	    """Semantic JSON equality for run params.
231	
232	    Object key order is ignored, array order is preserved, booleans are not
233	    numbers (``True != 1``), and numeric ints/floats compare by numeric value
234	    (``1 == 1.0``).
235	    """
236	    if isinstance(left, bool) or isinstance(right, bool):
237	        return isinstance(left, bool) and isinstance(right, bool) and left == right
238	    if isinstance(left, dict) or isinstance(right, dict):
239	        if not (isinstance(left, dict) and isinstance(right, dict)):
240	            return False
241	        if left.keys() != right.keys():
242	            return False
243	        return all(params_equal(left[name], right[name]) for name in left)
244	    if isinstance(left, list) or isinstance(right, list):
245	        if not (isinstance(left, list) and isinstance(right, list)):
246	            return False
247	        return len(left) == len(right) and all(
248	            params_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right)
249	        )
250	    if isinstance(left, (int, float)) and isinstance(right, (int, float)):
251	        return left == right
252	    return left == right

255	def _retry_due(step, now_iso):
256	    """Whether a ready step's backoff has elapsed (or it never failed).
257	
258	    ``next_attempt_at`` is set when a failure re-queues the step with
259	    remaining attempts; the step becomes claimable again only once the
260	    current time reaches that moment.  Both timestamps come from
261	    :func:`format_time`, so lexicographic comparison is chronological.
262	    """
263	    next_attempt_at = step.get("next_attempt_at")
264	    return next_attempt_at is None or next_attempt_at <= now_iso

267	def _active_lease_count(run, now):
268	    """Count ordinary tasks in this run holding a strictly unexpired lease.
269	
270	    Approval nodes and tasks that are ready, waiting, succeeded, failed or
271	    pending retry do not count; a deadline equal to ``now`` is expired.
272	    Each held task counts once, even when one worker holds several.
273	    """
274	    return sum(
275	        1
276	        for step in run["steps"].values()
277	        if step.get("kind") != KIND_APPROVAL
278	        and step["status"] == STEP_RUNNING
279	        and step.get("lease_deadline") is not None
280	        and float(step["lease_deadline"]) > now
281	    )

284	def _promote_pending(run, now_iso):
285	    """Promote pending steps whose dependencies all succeeded.
286	
287	    Ordinary tasks become ``ready``; approval steps become ``waiting`` for a
288	    human decision.  Returns ``(ready_ids, waiting_ids)``.
289	    """
290	    index = run["order_index"]
291	    ready, waiting = [], []
292	    for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: index.get(s, 0)):
293	        step = run["steps"][sid]
294	        if step["status"] != STEP_PENDING:
295	            continue
296	        if all(run["steps"][d]["status"] == STEP_SUCCEEDED for d in step["depends_on"]):
297	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
298	                step["status"] = STEP_WAITING
299	                waiting.append(sid)
300	            else:
301	                step["status"], step["ready_at"] = STEP_READY, now_iso
302	                ready.append(sid)
303	    return ready, waiting

306	def _derive_run_status(run):
307	    """Derive the run status from its steps; stays ``pending`` until claimed."""
308	    steps = list(run["steps"].values())
309	    if any(s["status"] == STEP_FAILED for s in steps):
310	        return RUN_FAILED
311	    if any(s["status"] == STEP_CANCELLED for s in steps):
312	        return RUN_CANCELLED
313	    if steps and all(s["status"] == STEP_SUCCEEDED for s in steps):
314	        return RUN_SUCCEEDED
315	    if any(s["status"] in (STEP_RUNNING, STEP_SUCCEEDED) for s in steps):
316	        return RUN_RUNNING
317	    return RUN_PENDING

330	class Scheduler:
331	    """Coordinates workers against a :class:`WorkflowStore`."""
332	
333	    def __init__(self, store, clock=None, backoff_base=1.0, sleep=None):
334	        self.store = store
335	        self._clock = clock if clock is not None else store.now
336	        self.backoff_base = float(backoff_base)
337	        self._sleep = sleep if sleep is not None else _time.sleep
338	
339	    def now(self):
340	        return float(self._clock())
341	
342	    def _iso(self, when=None):
343	        return format_time(self.now() if when is None else when)
344	
345	    def _event(self, run, run_id, step_id, etype, attempt=None, worker_id=None, **extra):
346	        event = {"at": self._iso(), "run_id": run_id, "step_id": step_id, "type": etype,
347	                 "attempt": attempt, "worker_id": worker_id}
348	        event.update(extra)
349	        run["history"].append(event)
350	        # Every persisted history event is also an audit record: run actions
351	        # keep their history type as the audit action and enter the tenant
352	        # stream in the order the changes actually happened.
353	        self.store.append_audit(run["tenant"], etype, at=event["at"], run_id=run_id,
354	                                step_id=step_id, workflow_id=run.get("workflow_id"),
355	                                worker_id=worker_id, actor=extra.get("actor"))
356	        return event

358	    # -- workflow / run lifecycle --------------------------------------
359	    def submit(self, tenant, workflow_id, steps):
360	        with self.store.locked():
361	            plan = self.store.save_workflow(tenant, workflow_id, steps)
362	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "workflow.submit",
363	                                    workflow_id=plan["workflow_id"])
364	            return plan

366	    def start_run(self, tenant, workflow_id, run_id=None, params=None, max_parallelism=None,
367	                  idempotency_key=None, not_before=None, schedule_id=None, scheduled_at=None):
368	        key = normalize_idempotency_key(idempotency_key)
369	        max_parallelism = normalize_max_parallelism(max_parallelism)
370	        if key is not None:
371	            params = normalize_params(params)
372	        not_before = normalize_not_before(not_before)
373	        with self.store.locked():
374	            if key is not None:
375	                return self._start_idempotent_run(
376	                    tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, max_parallelism, key, not_before,
377	                    schedule_id, scheduled_at
378	                )
379	            plan = self.store.get_workflow(tenant, workflow_id)
380	            run_id = run_id or self.store.generate_run_id()
381	            if self.store.run_exists(run_id) == tenant:
382	                raise WorkflowError("run already exists: %s" % run_id, "duplicate_run")
383	            run = new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, self._iso(),
384	                          max_parallelism=max_parallelism, not_before=not_before,
385	                          schedule_id=schedule_id, scheduled_at=scheduled_at)
386	            return self._create_run(run, plan)

388	    def _start_idempotent_run(self, tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, max_parallelism, key,
389	                              not_before, schedule_id=None, scheduled_at=None):
390	        """Create once per (tenant, trimmed key); replay identical requests.
391	
392	        Runs inside the store lock so concurrent identical requests share one
393	        run while differing requests conflict against the first creation.
394	        """
395	        index = self.store.load_idempotency(tenant)
396	        record = index.get(key)
397	        if record is not None:
398	            existing = self.get_run(tenant, record["run_id"])
399	            if run_id is not None and run_id != existing["run_id"]:
400	                raise ConflictError(
401	                    "idempotency_key %s is already bound to run %s"
402	                    % (key, existing["run_id"]),
403	                    "idempotency_conflict",
404	                )
405	            if existing["workflow_id"] != workflow_id \
406	                    or not params_equal(existing.get("params") or {}, params) \
407	                    or existing.get("max_parallelism") != max_parallelism \
408	                    or existing.get("not_before") != not_before:
409	                raise ConflictError(
410	                    "request differs from the run first created with idempotency_key %s" % key,
411	                    "idempotency_conflict",
412	                )
413	            # A repeat changes nothing: no history, no updated_at, no lease.
414	            return existing
415	        plan = self.store.get_workflow(tenant, workflow_id)
416	        run_id = run_id or self.store.generate_run_id()
417	        if self.store.run_exists(run_id) == tenant:
418	            raise WorkflowError("run already exists: %s" % run_id, "duplicate_run")
419	        run = new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, self._iso(),
420	                      max_parallelism=max_parallelism, idempotency_key=key,
421	                      not_before=not_before, schedule_id=schedule_id,
422	                      scheduled_at=scheduled_at)
423	        self._create_run(run, plan)
424	        index[key] = {"run_id": run_id}
425	        self.store.save_idempotency(tenant, index)
426	        return run

428	    def _create_run(self, run, plan):
429	        """Append creation events and persist a freshly built run.
430	
431	        A run with a future ``not_before`` stays fully ``pending``: its root
432	        nodes are opened (one ``ready``/``waiting`` history event each) only
433	        when the first claim arrives at or after that time.  A past, present
434	        or missing start time opens the roots immediately, exactly like the
435	        legacy create behavior.
436	        """
437	        run_id = run["run_id"]
438	        self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_created")
439	        not_before = run.get("not_before")
440	        if not_before is None or float(not_before) <= self.now():
441	            self._open_root_nodes(run)
442	        run["status"], run["updated_at"] = _derive_run_status(run), self._iso()
443	        return self.store.save_run(run)
444	
445	    def _open_root_nodes(self, run, when=None):
446	        """Promote every pending node whose dependencies all succeeded.
447	
448	        Each promoted node records exactly one ``ready`` or ``waiting``
449	        history event, so calling this on repeated claims never re-opens a
450	        node.  Returns ``(ready_ids, waiting_ids)``.
451	        """
452	        now_iso = self._iso() if when is None else when
453	        ready, waiting = _promote_pending(run, now_iso)
454	        for sid in ready:
455	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "ready",
456	                        attempt=run["steps"][sid]["attempt"])
457	        for sid in waiting:
458	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "waiting", attempt=0)
459	        return ready, waiting
460	
461	    def get_run(self, tenant, run_id):
462	        run = self.store.load_run(tenant, run_id)
463	        if run["tenant"] != tenant:
464	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
465	        return run
466	
467	    def list_runs(self, tenant, status=None, limit=50, after=None):
468	        return self.store.list_runs(tenant, status=status, limit=limit, after=after)
469	
470	    # -- audit stream ---------------------------------------------------
471	    def list_audit(self, tenant, action=None, run_id=None, limit=100, after=0):
472	        """Read the tenant's audit stream; never mutates any state.
473	
474	        Returns ``(items, next_after)`` where ``items`` are the tenant's
475	        audit records with ``sequence > after`` (optionally filtered by
476	        ``action`` and/or ``run_id``) in ascending sequence order, at most
477	        ``limit`` of them, and ``next_after`` is the sequence of the last
478	        record of the page, or ``None`` when no further records follow.
479	        Only the requesting tenant's own stream is ever read.
480	        """
481	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
482	        if action is not None:
483	            if not isinstance(action, str) or not action.strip():
484	                raise WorkflowError("action must be a non-empty string", "bad_action")
485	            action = action.strip()
486	        if run_id is not None:
487	            if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id.strip():
488	                raise WorkflowError("run_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_run_id")
489	            run_id = run_id.strip()
490	        if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int) or not 1 <= limit <= 1000:
491	            raise WorkflowError("limit must be an integer between 1 and 1000", "bad_limit")
492	        if isinstance(after, bool) or not isinstance(after, int) or after < 0:
493	            raise WorkflowError("after must be a non-negative integer", "bad_after")
494	        with self.store.locked():
495	            matched = [r for r in self.store.load_audit(tenant) if r["sequence"] > after]

502	        next_after = page[-1]["sequence"] if len(matched) > limit else None

562	        """Fire a schedule when due.

565	        ``(None, None)`` when the schedule is not yet due (HTTP 204).  Only
566	        the single due trigger point is processed per call: ``next_at``
567	        advances by exactly one interval, so a repeat before the next
568	        trigger is due changes nothing and missed trigger points are caught
569	        up one per call in chronological order.

579	                )

582	                    "schedule %s belongs to another tenant" % schedule_id, "cross_tenant"
583	                )

585	            record = schedules[schedule_id]

618	    def register_worker(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=None):
619	        """Register ``worker_id`` for ``tenant`` (or refresh its expiry).
620	
621	        Returns ``(record, created)`` where ``created`` is ``True`` for the
622	        first registration (HTTP 201) and ``False`` for a repeat that
623	        refreshed an existing record (HTTP 200).  Registration never writes
624	        run history.
625	        """
626	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
627	        worker_id = normalize_worker_id(worker_id)
628	        lease = normalize_worker_lease(lease_seconds)
629	        now = self.now()
630	        with self.store.locked():
631	            workers = self.store.load_workers(tenant)
632	            existing = workers.get(worker_id)
633	            deadline = now + lease
634	            at = self._iso(now)
635	            if existing is None:
636	                record = {
637	                    "worker_id": worker_id,
638	                    "registered_at": at,
639	                    "last_heartbeat": at,
640	                    "expires_at": self._iso(deadline),
641	                    "expires_at_epoch": deadline,
642	                }
643	                created = True
644	            else:
645	                # A repeat registration simply refreshes the expiry; the
646	                # original registered_at is preserved.
647	                record = dict(existing)
648	                record.update(last_heartbeat=at, expires_at=self._iso(deadline),
649	                              expires_at_epoch=deadline)
650	                created = False
651	            workers[worker_id] = record
652	            self.store.save_workers(tenant, workers)
653	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "worker.register", worker_id=worker_id)

725	    # -- lease expiry --------------------------------------------------
726	    def _expire_leases(self, run, now):
727	        """Release leases past their deadline; each one records a takeover."""
728	        reclaimed = []
729	        for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: run["order_index"].get(s, 0)):
730	            step = run["steps"][sid]
731	            if step["status"] != STEP_RUNNING:
732	                continue
733	            if step.get("lease_deadline") is None or float(step["lease_deadline"]) > now:
734	                continue
735	            holder = step["worker_id"]
736	            step.update(status=STEP_READY, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None, ready_at=self._iso())
737	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "takeover", attempt=step["attempt"], worker_id=holder)
738	            reclaimed.append(sid)
739	        return reclaimed

741	    # -- claim / complete / fail ---------------------------------------
742	    def claim(self, tenant, run_id, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
743	        """Lease the next ready step, or return ``None`` when none is ready.
744	
745	        A delayed run (a future ``not_before``) cannot be activated early:
746	        claims before the start time return ``None`` without touching its
747	        state, history or ``updated_at``.  The first claim at or after the
748	        start time opens the root nodes (one ``ready``/``waiting`` event each)
749	        and then leases at most one task under the usual order and quota; a
750	        run whose roots are all approvals activates and still returns ``None``.
751	
752	        Once the tenant has any registered worker the claim must come from an
753	        active registration (``worker_not_registered`` / ``worker_expired``);
754	        a tenant with no registrations keeps the legacy non-empty-id rule.
755	
756	        A ready step whose retry backoff is still pending
757	        (``next_attempt_at`` in the future) is not leased; other ready tasks
758	        whose backoff has elapsed are handed out in the usual order instead.
759	        When nothing is leased and no lease takeover or root activation
760	        happened, the run's state, history and ``updated_at`` are left
761	        exactly as stored.
762	        """
763	        if not isinstance(worker_id, str) or not worker_id.strip():
764	            raise WorkflowError("worker_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_worker")
765	        if not isinstance(lease_seconds, (int, float)) or isinstance(lease_seconds, bool) \
766	                or lease_seconds <= 0:
767	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
768	        now = self.now()
769	        with self.store.locked():
770	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
771	            if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
772	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
773	            # Once a tenant has any registered worker, claims require an
774	            # active registration; a tenant without records keeps the legacy
775	            # "any non-empty worker_id" rule.
776	            self._check_worker_registration(tenant, worker_id.strip(), now)
777	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
778	            not_before = run.get("not_before")
779	            if not_before is not None and float(not_before) > now:
780	                # Still sleeping: activation happens only via a due claim.
781	                return None
782	            reclaimed = self._expire_leases(run, now)
783	            opened_ready, opened_waiting = self._open_root_nodes(run)
784	            now_iso = self._iso()
785	            candidates = [s for s in run["steps"].values()
786	                          if s["status"] == STEP_READY and _retry_due(s, now_iso)]
787	            index = run["order_index"]
788	            quota = run.get("max_parallelism")
789	            at_quota = quota is not None and _active_lease_count(run, now) >= int(quota)
790	            step = (min(candidates, key=lambda s: (index.get(s["id"], 0), s["id"]))
791	                    if candidates and not at_quota else None)
792	            previous = run["status"]
793	            if step is not None:
794	                step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=worker_id, next_attempt_at=None,
795	                            lease_deadline=now + float(lease_seconds), started_at=self._iso())
796	                self._event(run, run_id, step["id"], "claim", attempt=step["attempt"],
797	                            worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=step["lease_deadline"])
798	            elif not reclaimed and not opened_ready and not opened_waiting:
799	                # Nothing to lease and nothing else changed: keep the stored
800	                # state, history and updated_at untouched.
801	                return None
802	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
803	            if step is not None and run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and previous == RUN_PENDING:
804	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_started")
805	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
806	            self.store.save_run(run)
807	            return dict(step) if step is not None else None
808	
809	    def claim_fair(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
810	        """Lease one task from the tenant's least-claimed eligible run.
811	
812	        Scans every run of the tenant.  First, sleeping runs whose
813	        ``not_before`` has come due are activated (root nodes opened, one
814	        ``ready``/``waiting`` event each) in ``run_id`` order.  Then the
815	        candidates — runs that are not terminal, not still sleeping, hold at
816	        least one ``ready`` ordinary task whose retry backoff has elapsed
817	        (``next_attempt_at`` reached) and have not reached their
818	        ``max_parallelism`` — are ordered by fairness: the number of
819	        ``claim`` events in the run's history (fewest first), then
820	        ``created_at``, then ``run_id``.  A run holding only not-yet-due
821	        retries is skipped and its fairness count is left alone.  Expired
822	        leases are reclaimed with the usual ``takeover`` events before slots
823	        are counted, exactly like the single-run claim.  The winner leases
824	        its next due task in ``(topological index, step id)`` order,
825	        recording the usual ``claim`` and, when the run leaves ``pending``,
826	        ``run_started`` events.
827	
828	        Returns ``(run_id, step)`` or ``None`` when no run is eligible; at
829	        most one task is leased per call.  The fairness count is rebuilt
830	        from the append-only history on every call, so restarts, replay and
831	        concurrent callers (serialized by the store lock) all agree.
832	        Worker-registration gating matches the single-run claim.
833	        """
834	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
835	        worker_id = normalize_worker_id(worker_id)
836	        lease = normalize_worker_lease(lease_seconds)
837	        now = self.now()
838	        with self.store.locked():
839	            self._check_worker_registration(tenant, worker_id, now)
840	            runs = self.store.load_all_runs(tenant)
841	            # Activate due sleeping runs in run_id order; already-activated
842	            # runs are left untouched.  Terminal runs (including a cancelled
843	            # run whose roots were never opened) are never activated.
844	            for run in runs:
845	                if run["status"] in TERMINAL_RUN_STATES:
846	                    continue
847	                not_before = run.get("not_before")
848	                if not_before is None or float(not_before) > now:
849	                    continue
850	                if _roots_opened(run):
851	                    continue
852	                self._open_root_nodes(run)
853	                run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
854	                run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
855	                self.store.save_run(run)
856	            # Pick the fairest eligible run.
857	            now_iso = self._iso(now)
858	            best_key, best_run, best_previous = None, None, None
859	            for run in runs:
860	                if run["status"] in TERMINAL_RUN_STATES:
861	                    continue
862	                not_before = run.get("not_before")
863	                if not_before is not None and float(not_before) > now:
864	                    continue
865	                previous = run["status"]
866	                reclaimed = self._expire_leases(run, now)
867	                if reclaimed:
868	                    run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
869	                    run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
870	                    self.store.save_run(run)
871	                ready = [s for s in run["steps"].values()
872	                         if s["status"] == STEP_READY and _retry_due(s, now_iso)]
873	                if not ready:
874	                    continue
875	                quota = run.get("max_parallelism")
876	                if quota is not None and _active_lease_count(run, now) >= int(quota):
877	                    continue
878	                claims = sum(1 for e in run["history"] if e.get("type") == "claim")
879	                key = (claims, run.get("created_at") or "", run["run_id"])
880	                if best_key is None or key < best_key:
881	                    best_key, best_run, best_previous = key, run, previous
882	            if best_run is None:
883	                return None
884	            run = best_run
885	            index = run["order_index"]
886	            step = min((s for s in run["steps"].values()
887	                        if s["status"] == STEP_READY and _retry_due(s, now_iso)),
888	                       key=lambda s: (index.get(s["id"], 0), s["id"]))
889	            step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=worker_id, next_attempt_at=None,
890	                        lease_deadline=now + lease, started_at=self._iso())
891	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], step["id"], "claim", attempt=step["attempt"],
892	                        worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=step["lease_deadline"])
893	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
894	            if run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and best_previous == RUN_PENDING:
895	                self._event(run, run["run_id"], None, "run_started")
896	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
897	            self.store.save_run(run)
898	            return run["run_id"], dict(step)
899	
900	    def heartbeat(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
901	        """Renew the lease on a running step held by ``worker_id``.
902	
903	        The new deadline is the later of the current one and
904	        ``now + lease_seconds``; only the deadline and ``updated_at`` change.
905	        A renewal that would not extend the deadline returns the run
906	        unchanged and appends no history.
907	        """
908	        if not isinstance(worker_id, str) or not worker_id.strip():
909	            raise WorkflowError("worker_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_worker")
910	        if not isinstance(step_id, str) or not step_id.strip():
911	            raise WorkflowError("step_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_step")
912	        if not isinstance(lease_seconds, (int, float)) or isinstance(lease_seconds, bool) \
913	                or not math.isfinite(lease_seconds) or lease_seconds <= 0:
914	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
915	        now = self.now()
916	        with self.store.locked():
917	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
918	            if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
919	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
920	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
921	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:
922	                raise ConflictError("run %s is cancelled" % run_id, "run_cancelled")
923	            if run["status"] in (RUN_SUCCEEDED, RUN_FAILED):
924	                raise ConflictError("run %s is already %s" % (run_id, run["status"]),
925	                                    "run_finished")
926	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
927	            if step is None:
928	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
929	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
930	                raise ConflictError(
931	                    "step %s is an approval node; use /decision" % step_id, "not_a_task"
932	                )
933	            if step["status"] != STEP_RUNNING:
934	                raise LeaseError("step %s is not running" % step_id, "lease_not_held")
935	            if step["worker_id"] != worker_id:
936	                raise LeaseError("step %s lease is not held by worker %s" % (step_id, worker_id))
937	            deadline = float(step["lease_deadline"])
938	            if now >= deadline:
939	                raise LeaseError("lease for step %s expired" % step_id, "lease_expired")
940	            new_deadline = max(deadline, now + float(lease_seconds))
941	            if new_deadline <= deadline:
942	                return run
943	            step["lease_deadline"] = new_deadline
944	            self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "heartbeat", attempt=step["attempt"],
945	                        worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=new_deadline)
946	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
947	            self.store.save_run(run)
948	            return run

950	    def _require_lease(self, run, step_id, worker_id):

952	        if step is None:
953	            raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
954	        if step["status"] == STEP_RUNNING and step["worker_id"] == worker_id:
955	            return step
956	        raise LeaseError("step %s lease is not held by worker %s" % (step_id, worker_id))

958	    def complete(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, worker_id, result=None):
959	        """Idempotent: repeating the same complete is a no-op."""
960	        now = self.now()
961	        with self.store.locked():
962	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
963	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:
964	                raise ConflictError("run %s is cancelled" % run_id, "run_cancelled")
965	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
966	            if step is None:
967	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
968	            if step.get("kind") == KIND_APPROVAL:
969	                raise ConflictError(

990	        """Count the attempt, retry with backoff, or fail the step and run."""
991	        now = self.now()
992	        with self.store.locked():
993	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
994	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:

1010	                            worker_id=worker_id)

1013	                            next_attempt_at=self._iso(now + backoff_seconds(
1014	                                step["attempt"], self.backoff_base)))

1016	                            worker_id=worker_id, next_attempt_at=step["next_attempt_at"])

1024	    # -- cancellation --------------------------------------------------
1025	    def cancel(self, tenant, run_id, actor):
1026	        """Cancel an unfinished run; a repeat cancel is a no-op.
1027	
1028	        Every non-terminal node (``pending``, ``ready``, ``running`` or
1029	        ``waiting``) becomes ``cancelled`` in ``step_order``; already
1030	        ``succeeded`` nodes are left untouched.  Cancelled nodes keep their
1031	        ``attempt``, ``result`` and ``error`` and release their lease
1032	        (``worker_id``, ``lease_deadline`` and ``next_attempt_at`` are
1033	        cleared).  Each cancelled node records one ``cancel`` history event
1034	        carrying the lease holder it had and the cancelling actor, and a
1035	        final run-level ``run_cancelled`` event closes the transition; the
1036	        audit stream follows the same order.  A sleeping run (a future
1037	        ``not_before``) is cancelled without opening its root nodes.
1038	
1039	        Cancelling never deletes the run, its workflow, its idempotency
1040	        binding or its history.  A run that is already ``succeeded`` or
1041	        ``failed`` conflicts (``run_finished``); a run that is already
1042	        ``cancelled`` returns the current document without new history,
1043	        audit records or a changed ``updated_at``.
1044	        """
1045	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
1046	        if not isinstance(actor, str):
1047	            raise WorkflowError("actor must be a string", "bad_actor")
1048	        actor = actor.strip()
1049	        if not actor:
1050	            raise WorkflowError("actor must be a non-empty string", "bad_actor")
1051	        with self.store.locked():
1052	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
1053	            if owner is None:
1054	                raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
1055	            if owner != tenant:
1056	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
1057	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
1058	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:
1059	                # Idempotent repeat: the stored document is returned as is.
1060	                return run
1061	            if run["status"] in (RUN_SUCCEEDED, RUN_FAILED):
1062	                raise ConflictError("run %s is already %s" % (run_id, run["status"]),
1063	                                    "run_finished")
1064	            index = run["order_index"]
1065	            for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: index.get(s, 0)):
1066	                step = run["steps"][sid]
1067	                if step["status"] in (STEP_SUCCEEDED, STEP_FAILED, STEP_CANCELLED):
1068	                    continue
1069	                holder = step.get("worker_id")
1070	                step.update(status=STEP_CANCELLED, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
1071	                            next_attempt_at=None)
1072	                self._event(run, run_id, sid, "cancel", attempt=step["attempt"],
1073	                            worker_id=holder, actor=actor)
1074	            run["status"] = RUN_CANCELLED
1075	            self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_cancelled", actor=actor)
1076	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
1077	            self.store.save_run(run)
1078	            return run

1080	    # -- human decisions -----------------------------------------------
1081	    def decide(self, tenant, run_id, step_id, actor, decision):
1082	        """Record a human approve/reject decision for an approval step.
1083	
1084	        Repeating the *same* decision from the *same* actor is idempotent and
1085	        returns the unchanged run; a different actor or the opposite decision
1086	        conflicts with the recorded decision.
1087	        """
1088	        if not isinstance(actor, str) or not actor.strip():
1089	            raise WorkflowError("actor must be a non-empty string", "bad_actor")
1090	        actor = actor.strip()
1091	        if decision not in ("approve", "reject"):
1092	            raise WorkflowError("decision must be 'approve' or 'reject'", "bad_decision")
1093	        with self.store.locked():
1094	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
1095	            if run["status"] == RUN_CANCELLED:
1096	                raise ConflictError("run %s is cancelled" % run_id, "run_cancelled")
1097	            step = run["steps"].get(step_id)
1098	            if step is None:
1099	                raise WorkflowError("unknown step: %s" % step_id, "unknown_step")
1100	            if step.get("kind") != KIND_APPROVAL:
1101	                raise ConflictError("step %s is not an approval node" % step_id, "not_an_approval")
1102	            recorded = step.get("approval")
1103	            if recorded is not None:
1104	                if recorded["actor"] == actor and recorded["decision"] == decision:
1105	                    return run
1106	                raise ConflictError(
1107	                    "step %s already decided by %s: %s"
1108	                    % (step_id, recorded["actor"], recorded["decision"]),
1109	                    "already_decided",
1110	                )
1111	            if step["status"] != STEP_WAITING:
1112	                raise ConflictError(
1113	                    "step %s is not waiting for a decision" % step_id, "not_waiting"
1114	                )
1115	            event = self._event(run, run_id, step_id, "decision", attempt=0, worker_id=None,
1116	                                actor=actor, decision=decision)
1117	            at = event["at"]
1118	            step["approval"] = {"actor": actor, "decision": decision, "at": at}
1119	            previous = run["status"]
1120	            if decision == "approve":
1121	                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED, finished_at=at)
1122	                self._open_root_nodes(run, at)
1123	                run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
1124	            else:
1125	                step.update(status=STEP_FAILED, finished_at=at)
1126	                run["status"] = RUN_FAILED
1127	            if run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and previous == RUN_PENDING:
1128	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_started")
1129	            if run["status"] == RUN_SUCCEEDED:
1130	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_succeeded")
1131	            elif run["status"] == RUN_FAILED:
1132	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_failed")
1133	            run["updated_at"] = at
1134	            self.store.save_run(run)
1135	            return run

1137	    # -- history / replay ----------------------------------------------
1138	    def replay(self, tenant, run_id):
1139	        """Rebuild run state from the run's frozen definition and history.
1140	
1141	        Nodes are rebuilt from the normalized DAG snapshotted into the run
1142	        document at creation time, never from the workflow currently stored
1143	        under the run's ``workflow_id``: a later same-name submission may
1144	        replace that workflow, but existing runs keep their original step
1145	        order, node kinds, dependencies, ``max_attempts`` and state-machine
1146	        semantics.  Documents written before snapshots existed reconstruct
1147	        the plan from the definitions and order saved in the run itself.
1148	
1149	        The result agrees with the persisted run on every observable field —
1150	        ``run_id``, ``workflow_id``, ``step_order``, run and per-step
1151	        ``status``, ``attempt``, ``worker_id``, ``lease_deadline``,
1152	        ``next_attempt_at``, ``ready_at``, ``started_at``, ``finished_at``,
1153	        ``result``, ``error`` and ``approval`` — and the append-only history
1154	        is the sole source of transitions, so replaying again, including
1155	        after a restart, yields the identical document.
1156	        """
1157	        owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
1158	        if owner is None:
1159	            raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
1160	        if owner != tenant:
1161	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
1162	        stored = self.store.load_run(tenant, run_id)
1163	        plan = run_plan(stored)
1164	        rebuilt = new_run(tenant, stored["workflow_id"], run_id, stored.get("params"), plan,
1165	                          stored["created_at"],
1166	                          max_parallelism=stored.get("max_parallelism"),
1167	                          idempotency_key=stored.get("idempotency_key"),
1168	                          not_before=stored.get("not_before"),
1169	                          schedule_id=stored.get("schedule_id"),
1170	                          scheduled_at=stored.get("scheduled_at"))
1171	        # The fresh document must carry exactly the frozen snapshot and
1172	        # ordering of the stored run (new_run fills them from the same plan
1173	        # already, but align them defensively for reconstructed old plans).
1174	        rebuilt["plan"] = copy.deepcopy(plan)
1175	        rebuilt["step_order"] = list(plan["order"])
1176	        rebuilt["order_index"] = {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(plan["order"])}
1177	        steps = rebuilt["steps"]
1178	        for event in stored["history"]:
1179	            sid, etype, at = event.get("step_id"), event.get("type"), event.get("at")
1180	            attempt = event.get("attempt")
1181	            if sid is None:
1182	                # Run-level markers (run_created, run_started, run_succeeded,
1183	                # run_failed, run_cancelled) need no replay action: the run
1184	                # status is derived from the rebuilt nodes at the end,
1185	                # exactly as every live transition derives it before
1186	                # persisting.
1187	                continue
1188	            step = steps.get(sid)
1189	            if step is None:
1190	                # The frozen definition has no node for this event: a node
1191	                # introduced by a later same-name workflow must not appear
1192	                # here, and old events can never reference a removed node.
1193	                continue
1194	            if etype == "ready":
1195	                step.update(status=STEP_READY, ready_at=at)
1196	            elif etype == "waiting":
1197	                step.update(status=STEP_WAITING)
1198	            elif etype == "claim":
1199	                step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=event.get("worker_id"),
1200	                            started_at=at, lease_deadline=event.get("lease_deadline"),
1201	                            next_attempt_at=None)
1202	            elif etype == "heartbeat":
1203	                step["lease_deadline"] = event.get("lease_deadline")
1204	            elif etype == "takeover":
1205	                # Mirrors _expire_leases: the node is re-queued with a fresh
1206	                # ready_at and no holder; started_at from the lost lease is
1207	                # left in place, exactly as the live transition leaves it.
1208	                step.update(status=STEP_READY, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
1209	                            ready_at=at)
1210	            elif etype == "complete":
1211	                # Mirrors complete(): the successful node keeps the worker
1212	                # that completed it and clears any prior failure error.
1213	                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED, result=event.get("result"), error=None,
1214	                            finished_at=at, lease_deadline=None,
1215	                            worker_id=event.get("worker_id"),
1216	                            attempt=step["attempt"] if attempt is None else attempt)
1217	            elif etype == "decision":
1218	                approved = event.get("decision") == "approve"
1219	                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED if approved else STEP_FAILED,
1220	                            finished_at=at,
1221	                            approval={"actor": event.get("actor"),
1222	                                      "decision": event.get("decision"), "at": at})
1223	            elif etype == "fail":
1224	                step.update(error=event.get("error"), worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
1225	                            attempt=step["attempt"] if attempt is None else attempt)
1226	            elif etype == "retry":
1227	                step.update(status=STEP_READY, ready_at=at,
1228	                            next_attempt_at=event.get("next_attempt_at"))
1229	            elif etype == "attempts_exhausted":
1230	                step.update(status=STEP_FAILED, finished_at=at, next_attempt_at=None)
1231	            elif etype == "cancel":
1232	                # Mirrors cancel(): the node keeps attempt/result/error and
1233	                # releases its lease; ready_at/started_at stay as recorded.
1234	                step.update(status=STEP_CANCELLED, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
1235	                            next_attempt_at=None)
1236	        # Every live write path derives the run status from its nodes, so
1237	        # rebuilding from the same nodes yields the same status — including
1238	        # the pending/running boundary (a run with only ready/waiting nodes
1239	        # and no claim is still pending; a retry-queued run has returned to
1240	        # pending even though a run_started event exists).
1241	        rebuilt["status"] = _derive_run_status(rebuilt)
1242	        rebuilt["updated_at"] = stored.get("updated_at")
1243	        rebuilt["history"] = copy.deepcopy(stored["history"])
1244	        return rebuilt

1	"""Standard library HTTP API for flowd."""
2	
3	import json
4	import re
5	from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
6	from urllib.parse import parse_qs, unquote, urlparse
7	
8	from .model import WorkflowError
9	from .scheduler import ConflictError, LeaseError
10	
11	MAX_BODY = 1 << 20
12	STATUS_FOR_CODE = {"unknown_run": 404, "unknown_workflow": 404, "unknown_step": 404,
13	                   "unknown_worker": 404, "unknown_schedule": 404,
14	                   "schedule_exists": 409, "cross_tenant": 403}
15	DECISIONS = ("approve", "reject")
16	
17	
18	class _Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
19	    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
20	    server_version = "flowd/0.1"
21	
22	    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # keep the console quiet
23	        pass
24	
25	    # -- plumbing ------------------------------------------------------
26	    def _send(self, code, raw=b""):
27	        self.send_response(code)
28	        if code != 204:
29	            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
30	        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
31	        self.end_headers()
32	        if raw:
33	            self.wfile.write(raw)
34	
35	    def _json(self, code, payload):
36	        self._send(code, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8"))
37	
38	    def _error(self, code, message):
39	        self._json(code, {"error": message})
40	
41	    def _body(self):
42	        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
43	        if length <= 0:
44	            return {}
45	        if length > MAX_BODY:
46	            raise WorkflowError("request body too large", "body_too_large")
47	        try:
48	            payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
49	        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
50	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be valid JSON", "bad_json")
51	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
52	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be a JSON object", "bad_json")
53	        return payload
54	
55	    def _tenant(self, query, body=None):
56	        tenant = (body or {}).get("tenant") or (query.get("tenant") or [None])[0]
57	        if not tenant:
58	            raise WorkflowError("tenant is required", "bad_tenant")
59	        return tenant
60	    # -- verbs ---------------------------------------------------------
61	    def do_GET(self):
62	        self._dispatch("GET")
63	
64	    def do_POST(self):
65	        self._dispatch("POST")
66	
67	    def _dispatch(self, method):
68	        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
69	        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/") or "/"
70	        try:
71	            self._route(method, path, parse_qs(parsed.query), parsed.query)
72	        except LeaseError as exc:
73	            self._error(409, exc.message)
74	        except ConflictError as exc:
75	            self._error(409, exc.message)
76	        except WorkflowError as exc:
77	            self._error(STATUS_FOR_CODE.get(exc.code, 400), exc.message)
78	        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
79	            self._error(500, "internal error: %s" % exc)
80	
81	    def _route(self, method, path, query, raw_query=""):
82	        body = {}
83	        if method == "GET":
84	            if path == "/healthz":
85	                return self._json(200, {"ok": True})
86	            if path == "/v1/runs":
87	                return self._list_runs(query)
88	            if path == "/v1/schedules":
89	                return self._list_schedules(query)
90	            if path == "/v1/workers":
91	                return self._list_workers(query)
92	            if path == "/v1/audit":
93	                # Blank values count as "provided" here: an empty tenant,
94	                # action or run_id is a 400, not a missing parameter.
95	                return self._list_audit(parse_qs(raw_query, keep_blank_values=True))
96	        elif method == "POST":
97	            if path == "/v1/tasks/claim":
98	                return self._claim_any_task(self._body())
99	            if path == "/v1/workers/register":
100	                return self._register_worker(self._body())
101	            worker_beat = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/workers/([^/]+)/heartbeat", path)
102	            if worker_beat:
103	                return self._worker_heartbeat(unquote(worker_beat.group(1)), self._body())
104	            if path == "/v1/workflows":
105	                body = self._body()
106	                tenant = self._tenant({}, body)
107	                plan = self.scheduler.submit(tenant, body.get("workflow_id"), body.get("steps"))
108	                return self._json(201, dict(plan, tenant=tenant))
109	            if path == "/v1/runs":
110	                body = self._body()
111	                run = self.scheduler.start_run(self._tenant({}, body), body.get("workflow_id"),
112	                                               body.get("run_id"), body.get("params"),
113	                                               body.get("max_parallelism"),
114	                                               body.get("idempotency_key"),
115	                                               body.get("not_before"))
116	                return self._json(201, _run_view(run))
117	            if path == "/v1/schedules":
118	                return self._create_schedule(self._body())
119	            schedule_dispatch = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/schedules/([^/]+)/dispatch", path)
120	            if schedule_dispatch:
121	                return self._dispatch_schedule(unquote(schedule_dispatch.group(1)), self._body())
122	            action = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)/(claim|complete|fail|decision|heartbeat|cancel)", path)
123	            if action:
124	                if action.group(2) == "decision":
125	                    return self._decision(action.group(1), self._body())
126	                if action.group(2) == "heartbeat":
127	                    return self._heartbeat(action.group(1), self._body())
128	                if action.group(2) == "cancel":
129	                    return self._cancel(action.group(1), self._body())
130	                return self._step_action(action.group(1), action.group(2), self._body())
131	        solo = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)", path)
132	        if method == "GET" and solo:
133	            return self._get_run(query, solo.group(1))
134	        return self._error(404, "no route for %s %s" % (method, path))

137	    def _get_run(self, query, run_id):

140	        if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
141	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
142	        return self._json(200, _run_view(self.scheduler.get_run(tenant, run_id)))
